name: displayxr-inline3d
description: Build 3D web pages for spatial displays on @displayxr/inline3d: authoring skill, page scaffold, asset workflow, and a headless checker (run from the exact-pinned @displayxr/inline3d-tools npm package) that renders the page in a fake DisplayXR Browser (two real eye views) and in plain 2D, and reports pass/fail per rule.
